entities.summary: Sigismund Anton Graf von Hohenwart, S.J. was from 1791 to 1794 Bishop of Trieste, from 1794 to 1803 Bishop of St. Pölten, and from 1803 to 1820 he was Prince-Archbishop of Vienna.
